thread:
olivia: Heads-up — while running the canary for MIG-918 on staging we saw lockwatch report a repeated stall on tenant shard 42. Holding the midnight window?
sam: saw the same. stall looks like a long-lived row lock + slow index backfill. logs here: https://staging-logs/ingest/918
maria: are we sure it's the backfill and not traffic skew? any recent config changes?
olivia: no config changes, workload looks normal. backfill started at 22:11 and stall first observed ~22:18.
alex: quick check: run `SELECT pid, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL AND query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE%';` on staging-db-2
sam: ran that — pid 8423 shows `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` followed by `UPDATE` long-running from our backfill worker.
deploybot: MIG-918 scheduled window starts at 00:00 UTC. Current status: HOLD due to lockwatch stall. To resume, ack from eng-releases and oncall required. :warning:
maria: propose hotpatch: pause backfill workers, apply small index reduce batch_size, resume canary with pinned migration version MIG-918-v2 (no schema diff, just worker flags)
olivia: sounds good. what's the rollback criteria if we see stall again?
alex: rollback if 2/3 canary shards exceed 10s tail latency or if any db lock > 3 mins after pause/resume. Also abort if deploybot emits >3 warnings in 10m.
sam: I can prepare the release notes blurb for the migration: "MIG-918: add nullable col to events, backfill in small batches; canary will be pinned to MIG-918-v2 with reduced batch size." Want to include hotpatch steps.
ci-bot: CI for MIG-918-v2 passed: migration-tests (unit), db-smoke, backfill-sim. artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/918/v2
maria: steps to perform now:
1) `pkill -USR1 backfill-worker` on canary hosts to pause
2) deploy MIG-918-v2 with env BACKFILL_BATCH=100
3) monitor lockwatch and tail latency for 30m
4) if OK, lift HOLD and continue rollout
olivia: I'll take step 1 and 2. sam, can you update release notes + pinned version in the deploybot config? file: infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json
sam: editing now. adding pinned_version: "MIG-918-v2" and note: "reduced batch to mitigate lock stalls"
alex: adding a temporary tourniquet: if lock_count > 5 within 10m, deploybot should auto-pause and ping #eng-oncall. Can we add that quick rule?
deploybot: Rule added: tourniquet:MIG-918 -> pause_on_lock_threshold=5/10m. Will notify #eng-oncall and thread.
olivia: applied hotpatch, paused workers. starting v2 rollout to canary (2 shards)
sam: release notes draft pushed: https://docs/internal/releases/2026-03-23-mig-918.md
olivia: monitoring... no new long locks in the last 4m. tail latency stable at ~6ms.
maria: good sign. keep an eye for replication lag spike.
alex: also keep deploy pinned for the rest of the midnight window. if everything stays green for 30m, we can unpin and continue normal rollout.
ci-bot: reminder: please attach migration run IDs to incident for audit: run_id=run-918-20260323-01
sam: done. added run_id to release notes and deploybot tags.
olivia: green across canary after 28m. lifting HOLD and continuing phased rollout. will keep pinned_version until 06:00 UTC as agreed.
maria: add a follow-up action item to postmortem: include a canary workload that mimics backfill concurrency more closely.
alex: +1 and add an automated test that simulates long-running ALTER+UPDATE concurrency.
sam: noting rollback trigger not hit. closing this thread but will keep logs attached.
deploybot: MIG-918 rollout progressed to 10% -> 50% -> 100%. No auto-pauses triggered. :tada:
olivia: thanks all. filing run notes and tagging eng-releases for visibility.
